func:
function embedParams(sql,params){if(!params)return sql;params=params.slice();for(var i=0;i<params.length;i++){var idx=sql.indexOf('?');if(idx<0)break;var v=params[i];var ev;if(v===null){ev='NULL';}else if(typeof v==='boolean'){ev=v?'1':'0';}else if(typeof v==='number'){ev=String(v);}else{ev="'"+String(v).replace(/'/g,"''")+"'";}sql=sql.substring(0,idx)+ev+sql.substring(idx+1);}return sql;}
var fname=msg.req.headers['x-filename']||'firmware.bin';var fkind=msg.req.headers['x-device']||'-1';if(!msg.payload){return null;}var data=Buffer.isBuffer(msg.payload)?msg.payload:Buffer.from(msg.payload);var size=data.length;var crc=(function(b){var c=0xFFFFFFFF;for(var i=0;i<b.length;i++){c^=b[i];for(var j=0;j<8;j++){c=(c>>>1)^(0xEDB88320&-(c&1));}}return('00000000'+((c^0xFFFFFFFF)>>>0).toString(16)).slice(-8);})(data);var ver=(fname.match(/v?(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/)||[])[1]||'';msg.topic='INSERT OR REPLACE INTO firmware(file,version,size,crc32,kind,uploaded_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)';msg.params=[fname,ver,size,crc,parseInt(fkind)||-1,Math.floor(Date.now()/1000)];msg._fname=fname;msg._data=data;msg._fwdir='/home/wtsn/wtsn-configurator/build/fw';msg.topic=embedParams(msg.topic,msg.params);return msg;

name: frameflows form
format:
FrameFlows (802.1Q)

Define each Ethernet frame flow (talker → listener). Create & push saves the table and pushes it to the TSN endpoint, which emits one 802.1Q-tagged frame per flow (visible in Wireshark). VLAN ID comes from the TSN endpoint config.
Arrival models: Sporadic=irregular gaps (spread by jitter) · Periodic=fixed period · Isochronous=strict fixed period · Burst=`burst` frames each period · Mixed=alternates single/burst · Random=random period (0.5–2×).
SenderReceiverPCP 0-7TaggedArrival modelPeriod (ms)Jitter (ns)Burst

name: join flow+class+vlan
sql: SELECT f.sender AS sender, f.receiver AS receiver, f.pcp AS pcp, f.vlan_tagged AS vlan_tagged, f.arrival_model AS arrival_model, f.period_ms AS period_ms, f.jitter_ns AS jitter_ns, f.burst AS burst, v.vlan_id AS vlan_id, v.vlan_name AS vlan_name, vc.send_activity AS send_activity, tc.express AS express, tc.scheduling AS scheduling, tc.name AS class_name, tc.flow AS class_flow, tx.tx_offset_us AS tx_offset_us FROM frame_flows f LEFT JOIN vlan_classifications v ON v.frame = (f.sender || ' -> ' || f.receiver) LEFT JOIN vlan_configs vc ON vc.vlan = v.vlan_name LEFT JOIN traffic_classes tc ON tc.flow = (f.sender || ' -> ' || f.receiver) LEFT JOIN tx_offset_configs tx ON tx.flow = (f.sender || ' -> ' || f.receiver) ORDER BY f.id

name: fmt vswitch ports
func: var rows=msg.payload||[]; if(!Array.isArray(rows)){rows=[];} context.global.set('HTSN_SAVED_VSW', rows.map(function(r){ return {port:String(r.port||''),pvid:Number(r.pvid)||1,allowed:r.allowed||'',pcpmap:r.pcpmap||'',cbs_kbps:Number(r.cbs_kbps)||0,preempt:!!r.preempt}; })); if(rows.length===0){msg.payload='(no switch ports configured)';return msg;} msg.payload=rows.map(function(r){return 'port '+r.port+' | pvid '+r.pvid+' | allowed '+(r.allowed||'-')+' | pcp '+(r.pcpmap||'-')+' | cbs '+r.cbs_kbps+' | preempt '+r.preempt;}).join('\n'); return msg;
